slides.headline: Describe it, edit it, own it
slides.say: Wait... you can describe a video and get an editable project? Yes. You really can.

slides.headline: Turn words into editable video
slides.body: Describe any video, get a full project you can tweak frame by frame
slides.say: You describe a video in plain words, and this tool gives you a complete project you can change down to the frame.

slides.headline: 87,620 GitHub stars
slides.body: Apache-2.0 licence · Written in TypeScript · Since March 2026
slides.say: It has over 80 thousand stars on GitHub and uses the Apache-2.0 licence.

slides.headline: Pro plan adds cloud AI models
slides.body: Free version renders locally with no watermark; Pro is $25 a month for hosted AI
slides.say: The free version renders on your computer with no watermark. The Pro plan at twenty-five dollars a month adds HeyGen's top AI video, image, and voice models in the cloud.
